channel.title: Michael McIntyre's The Wheel
channel.desc: Michael McIntyre hosts his hit game show packed with huge stars, big laughs and a giant spinning wheel. Can the contestants answer their way to a fortune? The celebrity experts in this episode are Italian Bach, Kerry Godliman, Trevor Nelson, Angela Scanlon, Alex Scott, Josh Widdicombe, Bez and Shaun Ryder.
